decisions.decision: D-07 deviation: switched from lazy execute-on-submit to onSuccess auto-mint pattern
decisions.rationale: Invisible mode auto-mints token on widget render; trying to imperatively await via execute()/getResponsePromise() created an unfightable race with Cloudflare's script initialization timing. New pattern uses onSuccess callback to capture token to state, then handleSubmit reads from state. Behavioral intent preserved (no manual challenge, fresh tokens per submit via reset).
Incompatible with `size: 'invisible'` — Cloudflare returned 400020 errors in a loop while these two flags were both set. Invisible mode has its own complete render behavior; appearance is irrelevant.
